meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'atmosphere, vibe' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Создавайте прекрасную атмосферу в зале нашего заведения!
examples.trans: Create a wonderful atmosphere in the hall of our establishment!

examples.text: Там великолепный вид и совершенно волшебная атмосфера.
examples.trans: There is a magnificent view and completely magical atmosphere.
We have nobody to fear here.

examples.text: Это наш город. Нам здесь бояться некого.
examples.trans: This is our town. We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('tasty, delicious').

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, присядьте. Попробуйте чай с сушками, очень вкусные.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, have a seat. Try the tea with bread rings, they're very tasty.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun
neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cook; to prepare', paired with 'приготовить'.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outside
meanings.note: гулять с собакой = to walk the dog

examples.trans: A girl walks a little dog there.
Let's go for a walk in the park.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.
A tall tree grows in the courtyard.

examples.text: Работает она много. А на сцену выходит — превращается в дерево.
examples.trans: She works a lot. But when she goes out on stage, she turns into a tree.

дослушивать.gloss: to listen to the end, to hear out

meanings.en: to listen to the end, to hear out
meanings.note: to listen until someone finishes speaking

examples.text: Дослушивать надо людей, когда они говорят.
examples.trans: One must listen to people when they speak.

examples.text: Дослушивать надо людей, когда они говорят!
examples.trans: One must listen to people when they speak!

examples.text: В этом ресторане всегда свежая еда.
examples.trans: There is always fresh food in this restaurant.
Oh no, bad food? Does your stomach hurt?
Understood. And who is managing the dining room?

заносить.gloss: to bring in, to carry in

meanings.en: to bring inside, to carry in
meanings.note: to transport or carry items into a building

examples.trans: Workers are bringing palm trees into the restaurant.

examples.text: Осторожно заносите эти пальмы в ресторан!
examples.trans: Carefully bring these palms into the restaurant!
Let the workers through, bring the trees inside!

examples.text: У вас будет всё, что захотите.

examples.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?
We went to an Italian restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: in business, sport or an election

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
And the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Аникеев лично сюда приезжал, и что?
examples.trans: Anikeev came here in person, and what?

examples.text: Пятнадцать лет мы просим новое здание! Аникеев лично сюда приезжал, и что?
examples.trans: For fifteen years we've been asking for a new building! Anikeev came here in person, and what?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

открыться.gloss: to open, to come to light

meanings.en: to come to light, to be revealed

examples.trans: New circumstances have come to light.

examples.text: Прошу внимания. Открылись новые обстоятельства по другому делу.
examples.trans: May I have your attention. New circumstances have come to light in another case.

meanings.note: tropical unbranched tree with a crown of large leaves

examples.trans: Real palm trees were placed in the dining room.

examples.text: Осторожно заносите эти пальмы в ресторан!
examples.trans: Carefully bring these palms into the restaurant!

examples.text: Зачем вам в зале настоящие пальмы?
examples.trans: Why do you need real palm trees in the dining room?

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

поесть.gloss: to eat, to have a meal

meanings.en: to eat, to have something to eat

examples.text: Ну ладно, брось! Мы только поедим.
examples.trans: Oh come on, stop it! We'll only eat.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'верить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to check, to test', paired with 'проверять'.

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву. Паяльник проверь.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood. Check the soldering iron.

meanings.en: to let through, allow to pass
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'пустить'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to let through, pass'.

examples.text: Слышишь, братан, пропусти нас скорее вперёд.
examples.trans: Listen, bro, let us through forward quickly.

examples.text: Этот инспектор не пропустит ни одной ошибки.
examples.trans: This inspector won't miss a single mistake.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.

meanings.note: + infinitive: решил стать = decided to become

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Do you know the main thing?

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.
You create unnecessary problems for us.
The artist creates a new painting.

examples.text: Ты всегда создаёшь нам большие проблемы.
examples.trans: You always create big problems for us.

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: на улице = out on the street / outside
на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.
There are reporters out on the street!

meanings.note: giving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation

examples.trans: A cozy restaurant in the city center.
This creates a cozy Italian atmosphere.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: + accusative: через неделю = in a week

examples.text: Нормально? Она через неделю снова потечёт!
examples.trans: Fine? It'll be leaking again in a week!

meanings.note: Core Russian num meaning 'six' in everyday speech.
pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
